semantics: deterministic integer transform residual floor (conventional-coder behavior inside VOLE). A new residual block kind (KIND_TSF = 2, tag 0x2a) codes the signed residual field target - base over aligned 4x4 blocks with a separable integer lifting DCT: rotations factor into three reversible Q8 lifting steps (even part theta = -pi/4: A = 106, B = -181; odd part theta = -pi/8: A = 51, B = -98; signed >> 8 is floor, consistent both directions), so the transform is lossless integer arithmetic with no floating point and no quantization. Wire: [2][tfm=0][skip mask ceil(Bx*By/8) bytes, LSB-first, pad bits must be 0][u32 dc_len][u32 ac_len][dc container][ac container]; dc = 4 bytes (zigzag u32 LE) per coded block, ac = 60 bytes per coded block, in row-major block order; edge blocks zero-padded. Decoder inverse-transforms (columns then rows) and adds the reconstruction back; results outside 0..=255 are OutOfBounds. Encoder: the TRANSFORM_RESIDUAL family is evaluated by the exhaustive court whenever 9k (raw point residual) >= mask+64, and by the fixed-heuristic/DSFB probe only when the diff is also dense (>= canvas/16); DSFB governs it like every other family (Full when active, Probe on the rotating sweep). Accounting: inline models are a sub-bucket (model_bytes) excluded from residual_bytes so the ten buckets still sum to the stream length exactly (fixes a latent double count for rANS point residuals).

candidate_gates.transform_full: 9k >= mask_len + 64 (possible win over the point-list floor)

hostile.parse: unknown transform id, set padding mask bit, dc_len/ac_len disagreement, truncation -> typed (NonCanonicalEncoding / Truncated) before the trailer runs
hostile.materialize: flipping a rANS model byte inside a DC container -> typed EntropyCorrupt at materialization; a hand-built RAW-container payload with a huge zigzag coefficient -> typed OutOfBounds (reconstruction outside Gray8)
hostile.unit: crate-internal apply-layer courts in src/transform.rs: exact application, unknown id, padding bit, length disagreement, out-of-range coefficient, truncation

test_count: tests/phase_m.rs (9 courts) + src/transform.rs unit courts (7); full gate: cargo fmt --check, cargo check --all-targets, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, cargo test --all-features (176 tests, 0 failures, dev and release)
notes: Normative format change: residual block kind 2 (transform-coded); transform id 0; no new tag, no new Limits field (payload bounded by max_residual_bytes; decode work bounded by the block count of the canvas).

The lifting-DCT is exact by construction (each stage is an invertible integer map; butterflies halve exactly on canonical streams) and the roundtrip property inverse(forward(x)) == x is asserted over thousands of random blocks plus the encoder's end-to-end decode verification.

Accounting fix recorded, not hidden: rANS point residuals previously double-counted their 512 B inline model (model_bytes inside residual_bytes); models are now a sub-bucket so the ten buckets sum exactly.

Phase H re-measurement recorded: the fixed-heuristic scroll-by-7 court no longer measures raw-rebase count (the transform floor absorbs dense scroll frames at ~950 B); it now measures cost - 23 385 B vs 2 883 B (8.1x, pre-Phase-M measurement was 11.5x by rebase). Copy blindness of the fixed probe is unchanged.
4x4-only in v1; block-size extension and per-position coefficient contexts are recorded Phase-O surface (coefficient streams use one order-0 byte model per container in v1).
A transform residual never wins on tiny diffs (gate) or noise (measured); the floor is one more bounded candidate the cost court may reject - the court decides, never the family's existence.
